assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 叙事导视带涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 口述史与历史影像内容来源为公开史料与自愿采集，仅作概念性展示设计引用，不替代权威史志，涉及个体信息部分匿名化处理并经授权。
assumptions.statement_en: Oral-history and archival content is concept-level display design only, not authoritative historiography.

assumptions.statement_zh: 站牌叙事站、道钉符号步道与信号声音亭设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 人流密度感知与标识动态调配仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Density sensing and sign dynamic allocation process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 京张叙事导览周、口述史采集工作坊与标识设计共创节等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
